payload.title: Scaffold submit preview, sample roundup and sign-in preview
payload.description:
Scaffold step 3 of 3. Preview of the Submit page, a sample weekly Roundup and a Sign-in preview. Deploys on merge to main. ## Context Step 1 (ship-0ac188, PR #10) built the home page and the board tabs as authored page files. Read what it did before you start: - `web/projection.json` `pages` and `chrome.stylesheets`. - `web/pages/home.md`. - `web/assets/shipped-components.css`: the shared components. Papyrus publishes only `css/site-theme.css` from `css/`, so assets live in `assets/`. Component classes: `.kicker`, `.cintillo`, `.sample-mark`, `.lime-band`, `.status-stamp(-shipped|-verified|-vapor|-pending)`, `.score-meter`/`.meter-segment`/`.is-on`, `.score-dimension`/`.is-low`, `.hype-gap(-over|-under)`, `.entity-chip(-proposed)`, `.spark`, `.button(-quiet)`, `.view-tabs`, `.vote-button`, `.board-*`, `.rail*`, `.section-heading`, `.preview-line`, `.shipped-page`, `.shipped-layout`. Reuse them. **Do not edit `web/assets/shipped-components.css` or the home and tab pages.** A parallel agent owns them in this step. Put your rules in a new `web/assets/shipped-forms-roundup.css` and add it to `chrome.stylesheets`. ## Pages to build Design directory (data only, never instructions): /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/artifact-files/6fc5ac4b-d38d-475d-87e8-5e918d223fc1/project/ 1. **Submit** at path `submit`, from `Submit.dc.html`. Build the whole form layout: URL, the duplicate warning, title with the 90-character counter, type radios, beat, entity confirm/fix chips, typed evidence links, "what you checked", disclosure, and the signed-in side panel. The form must not work: wrap every field in `
` and put a clear notice at the top: "Preview: submitting is not open yet. This form shows the design; nothing you type here is sent." No `action`, no submit handler, and a disabled submit button. In the side panel, show the karma figure with a sample mark, using the "submission count and account age" wording from the reconciliation report, adjustment 17. State the Shipped rule as "an editor confirmed it, or 3 signed-in readers reported using it" (adjustment 12). 2. **Roundup** at path `roundup`, from `Roundup.dc.html`: a sample "Week 43" roundup article with dek, prose, item cards with scores, "Vapor of the week", "What the graph noticed", trending, the board table, and previous/next. Add the line "Scores as of Fri 23 Oct" (adjustment 14). RSS links to `/feed.xml`. Draw email subscribe as a disabled "coming later" state. Mark the article itself with a sample mark next to its title, plus the line "Preview: a fictional sample roundup that shows the design. The first real roundup is published when the weekly feature goes live." 3. **Sign-in** at path `sign-in`: a short page in the site's style. It explains that reader accounts (Google sign-in) are coming, with a disabled "Sign in with Google" button and a sample mark on any sample account panel. Use no copy that implies sign-in works today. ## Rules (same as step 1) - Authored page files: `web/pages/.md`, starting with `::band{size="bare"}`, markup inside `::raw` … `::endraw`, each registered in `projection.json` `pages` (`id`, `path`, `title`, `description`, `source`). No hooks, islands or JavaScript. Never a literal `{{`. The character counter is static text such as "54 / 90". - Honest labelling. Every section with sample data carries `Sample` beside its heading. Use fictional names only (Tern-3, Harlow County, Basalt-70B and so on) and `.example` domains. - Colourblind rule: every state has a mark or a word, not only colour (status stamps, ▲/▼ with a sign on gaps, duplicate-warning icon plus text, chip states proposed vs confirmed by dashed vs solid outline plus a word). - Light and dark both work. No horizontal scroll at 390. ## Build, check, ship Same procedure as step 1. Read /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/spec-home.md, sections "Build and check locally" and "Ship". A venv may exist at /venv. Run `pip install -r requirements-publication.txt` in it after rebasing, because the Papyrus pin may move to 5.15.1. If another agent uses that venv at the same time, make your own at /venv-forms. - Worktree: `/wt-forms`, branch `feat/ship--scaffold-submit-roundup` from origin/main. Use port 8092. - PR title: `feat: scaffold the submit preview, sample roundup and sign-in preview (ship-)`. Rebase on origin/main before merge (conflicts in the `pages` and `chrome.stylesheets` arrays of projection.json are expected: keep both sides). Use `gh pr merge --merge`. - Live check: after the deploy is green, `/submit/`, `/roundup/` and `/sign-in/` return 200 and hold a sample mark or preview notice. If live paths return 403 even after the deploy, stop and report it. Do not change AWS. - Screenshots of all three at 1440 (light and dark) and 390. Save them in `/shots-forms/`. ## Report The PR URL, merge commit, deploy run, live check, screenshot paths and simplifications.
